stories.title: Define Weighting Schema and Persistence Contract
stories.description: Define data model for user-adjustable weights across quality measures, including defaults, bounds, normalization rules, and persistence format for reuse across sessions.

stories.title: Implement Weighted Scoring Logic
stories.description: Extend provider and clinical trial scoring engines to apply user-defined weights to individual measures and recompute composite scores deterministically with normalization.
stories.evidence: GAP: Existing scoring engines do not support dynamic weighting

stories.title: Expose Weight Adjustment API and UI Controls
stories.description: Create backend endpoints and frontend controls (e.g., sliders) to allow users to adjust weights and trigger score recalculation in real time.

stories.title: Integrate Weighting into Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate weighting inputs into evaluate_care_facade so both provider and clinical trial evaluations return recalculated scores based on user preferences.

stories.title: Weighting Logic Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit tests for weighting calculations and integration tests validating end-to-end score changes when weights are adjusted across provider and trial flows.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing tests for weighting behavior
